description: Uses passive voice: 'A pet can be added by sending a POST request.' Should use active voice per style guide.
suggested_fix: Change to: 'Send a POST request to add a pet.'

description: petId parameter description only says 'ID of pet to return.' Does not specify data type constraints or valid ranges.
suggested_fix: Add: 'Must be a positive integer (int64). Returns 400 if invalid.'

description: No code example provided for placing an order. Developers have reported confusion about required vs optional fields.
suggested_fix: Add curl and Python examples showing minimal and full request bodies.

description: The 'status' parameter is deprecated in the API spec but the documentation does not mention this or provide an alternative.
suggested_fix: Add deprecation notice with migration guidance.

description: Does not document that OAuth2 scope 'write:pets' is required. Users are getting 403 errors without understanding why.
suggested_fix: Add authentication requirements section with required scopes.

description: Multipart form data fields 'additionalMetadata' and 'file' are mentioned but content type restrictions and file size limits are not documented.
suggested_fix: Document supported image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF) and maximum file size (5MB).

description: Response described as 'map of status codes to quantities' but no example response body is shown. Format of the map object is ambiguous.
Response headers X-Rate-Limit and X-Expires-After are returned but not documented. Developers need these for rate limiting implementation.
suggested_fix: Document each response header with type, description, and example values.

description: Description says 'name that need to be deleted' - grammatical error and semantically incorrect (this is an update, not a delete).
suggested_fix: Change to: 'The username of the account to update.'

description: Endpoint is deprecated but no alternative approach is documented. Developers are still using this endpoint heavily.
suggested_fix: Add deprecation banner with sunset date and migration instructions to use findByStatus or direct pet lookup.

description: States 'This can only be done by the logged in user' but api_key security is defined. Contradiction between description and actual auth mechanism.
suggested_fix: Clarify: requires api_key authentication header. Update description to match.

description: Error response schema (code + message) exists in spec but individual endpoint docs don't reference it consistently. No standard error handling guide.
suggested_fix: Create unified error handling section. Document all standard error codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 405, 500).

description: Mixed usage of 'pet store' vs 'Petstore' vs 'Pet Store' throughout documentation. No defined canonical form.
suggested_fix: Standardize to 'Petstore' (one word, capital P) per product naming. Add to terminology list.

description: orderId parameter is typed as 'string' in the spec but the description implies it should be an integer. Other order endpoints use int64.
suggested_fix: Flag inconsistency to API team. Document current behavior (string) with note about expected integer values.

description: Description is identical to /user/createWithArray. Should differentiate between array and list input formats.
suggested_fix: Update description to explain when to use each endpoint and the difference in input format.
